name: APEX-011-25 Second-Order SQL Injection
description: 一个注册系统，其中恶意用户名被安全存储，但随后在管理员查询中被执行
hint: 注册时用户名被安全存储，但管理员查看活动日志时未做参数化查询，关注二次触发点
attack_phases: Phase 1: Register account with SQL injection payload as username
Phase 2: Trigger admin functionality that uses stored username
Phase 3: Injection executes in admin context, revealing flag

description.en: A registration system where malicious usernames are safely stored but later executed in admin queries

hint.en: 注册时用户名被安全存储，但管理员查看活动日志时未做参数化查询，关注二次触发点
